key_idea: Header lengths depend on the indices and vice versa; iterate from the smallest possible digit lengths to a fixed point, which is monotone and therefore the shortest representation.
sketch: Number bracket pairs in preorder and compute subtree sizes with a stack. Header i starts at pos[i]; its 'start' is pos[i+1] and its 'end' is pos[i+size_i]. Begin with every header length 4 (two one-digit numbers), recompute positions and digit counts, and repeat until nothing changes; lengths only grow so it converges to the least fixed point in a handful of rounds. At most 2000 pairs, so each round is O(n). Pitfall: 'end' is the position after the last descendant header, not after the header itself.
